messages.author: Kenji Nakamura
messages.text: CERT-7710 and CERT-7725 both list BRK-4471 at rev B as a covered component — a Class I change on it invalidates them. CERT-7731 does not list the bracket; the sensor mast keeps its certificate. 7702 and 7690 are dead paper.

messages.author: Célia Baptiste
messages.text: Wednesday is the customer audit freeze on every line. If anyone wants a second-shift cut-in, that is a separate request to Chidi — nothing pre-approved.

messages.author: Rowan Hale
messages.text: Whatever date we commit at the change meeting has to survive the audit. The rev B fixture sets in the crib do not fit rev C.
